Joan: ✨ Afternoon check-in for release train Bravo — cut scheduled at 18:00 UTC. Short status please (WHAT I DID / BLOCKERS / TODAY). Note: we still have the gpu-alloc backport + one flaky e2e in canary.

Alex: WHAT I DID: merged scheduler patch to staging, kicked off perf run. BLOCKERS: need final approval on cherry-pick PR #4823. TODAY: will chase approvals and stand by for merge.

Maya: WHAT I DID: ran perf harness on staging, found a 6% p99 regression in routing under 128-token loads. BLOCKERS: perf run uses prod-ish dataset copy that's still pending. TODAY: will finish review of PRs once dataset available; can review #4823 if someone drops a link.

Sam: WHAT I DID: investigated canary failures — saw OOMs in dedup-worker during long sequences. ACTION: restarted canary allocs and bumped memory for dedup-worker. Command used: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/dedup-worker -n bravo-canary` BLOCKERS: watching for recurrence; if OOMs reappear we'll need to roll back the canary model variant.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment for release-train-bravo succeeded on node-pool bravo-canary-1 — 2026-03-17T13:10:05Z.

Sam: Restarted, logs look cleaner now. Monitoring window until 17:00 UTC. If stable, we can include cherry-pick #4823 in the cut.

Alex: Cherry-pick status: PR 4823 -> https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/release/4823 ready, needs 2nd approval. Small change in scheduler config. @Maya can you give a quick review?

Maya: On it — will review in ~15m. Also will re-run the perf harness after the dataset copy completes.

Joan: Plan: Sam will watch canary until 17:00; Alex to chase approvals/merge; Maya to finish review + perf. If canary degrades again, fallback plan is automatic switch to v2-model (lower throughput) until we patch. Everyone OK?

TriageBot: triage-bot: Created incident INC-2026-183 (Canaries failing in eu-west-1) — assigned to Sam. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-183

Alex: Quick FYI — I'm out 16:30–17:30 UTC (calendar), but will respond to urgent pings.

Maya: Review posted, left one tiny comment. Overall LGTM. @Alex once green pls merge & backport.

Joan: Thanks all — moving this to "monitoring". If anyone hits a blocker, drop logs here or ping oncall. Thumbs if no other blockers :thumbsup:
